name: devmesh
description: A provider-ready software development agent framework with one-prompt full-stack product builds, routing, risk control, planning, implementation, debugging, Playwright browser automation, Browser QA, regression testing, security, accessibility, performance, multi-agent review, QA reporting, project memory, code review, and Git delivery. Codex is the first supported adapter.

interface.shortDescription: Autonomous full-stack engineering workflow mesh for coding agents
interface.longDescription: DevMesh turns concise product requests into evidence-based engineering workflows, including one-prompt full-stack builds with frontend, backend/server logic, APIs and persistence when required, plus risk assessment, planning, implementation, debugging, real Playwright browser automation, Browser QA, regression tests, security, accessibility, performance, independent review, project memory, QA reports, code review, and delivery. Codex is the first supported adapter.
defaultPrompt: Build a working full-stack web app from this product request.
Find the root cause, fix it, add regression coverage, and verify it.
Launch this web app and perform full Browser QA with evidence.
